description: The widget's `touched` under a computed name, a template literal (`member-overridden-under-a-computed-name` holds a string). TypeScript calls the property `touched`, and Angular reflects no name for it (`reflectClassMember`): `[touched]` on the widget binds no input (NG8002). The gate reads the name Angular does, and point 3 refuses the widget and says where the declaration that is none stands.
